resources.string: Use at least 12 characters. A long, unique passphrase is best.
Choose the language you want to learn
Sign in again to reconnect. Your saved conversations stay on this device.
Subscriptions are managed separately. Friends’ copies and backups saved elsewhere remain.
This account is already active on another device. Moving your account needs a separate confirmation.
Chats with friends are end-to-end encrypted.
Unblock this person to send a new message.
Your payment is pending in Google Play. Access starts after payment is confirmed.
We couldn’t verify this sign-in. Please start again.
Your plan access couldn’t be checked. Try again.
Connect once to finish setting up this device.
Keep your backup password. Vipi cannot recover it. Your saved chats and backups remain accessible if your plan ends.
The download couldn’t finish. Check your connection and try again.
You can exchange new messages again. Stopped messages won’t be resent.
Open Google Play → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions.
Sign in to see the plans available for your account.

This signs out whichever other device is active. Chats already on this device stay here. Waiting messages cannot move between devices and will stop. Your encryption keys change; friends will need to approve them and compare security numbers again.
Your friend’s encryption identity changed. Review the new keys before sending another message. Your saved history stays here.
Use 3–24 English letters, numbers or underscores. Start with a letter. Your phone number and contacts stay private.
Translation isn’t ready. Download this language first, then try again.
Your purchase is awaiting verification. Restore purchases to try again; don’t buy it again.

Messages you send here and recent vBot conversation context go to Vipi and DeepSeek for replies. This is a service chat, not an end-to-end encrypted conversation with a friend. Friend chats are never included.
Chat with friends.\nLearn words as you read.
Start or restore your Vipi plan before adding Bot mini.
Your email is not shown to friends.
Say hello. Your messages are end-to-end encrypted.
Please wait a moment before trying again. Your messages are saved.

These downloads are for optional full-message translation. Word switching does not need them. To translate a whole message, choose Full translation in its reading options. Messages stay on this phone.
Use 3–24 letters, numbers or underscores, starting with a letter.
Your plan access couldn’t be checked.
Your account moved to another device. Your saved conversations are still available here.
You can always read saved conversations and delete your account, even without an active plan.
Available words and phrases vary by language. Pronunciation may need a voice download.
That username isn’t available. Try another.
Encryption updated. Previous waiting messages stopped. Compare the new security number with your friend.
If any group differs, don’t mark it as verified. A new phone or reinstalled app can change these numbers.
This message expired before delivery. You can send it again.
Start or restore Vipi before adding Bot mini.
Retrying keeps the same report, so it is not submitted twice.
Know when friends reply. Notifications hide message text.
Please sign in again to reconnect your account. Your saved conversations are still on this device.
We couldn’t open secure sign-in. Please try again.
Sign-in isn’t available yet. Please try again shortly.
This is an example. In your chats, only supported words and phrases switch. The rest stays unchanged.
Messages between you will stop. Your chat stays on this device. You can unblock anytime.
Your saved conversations couldn’t be opened. Please close and reopen Vipi to try again.
Highlighted words switch between your two languages. This is a prepared example; available words in your chats vary by language. You can also view a prepared full translation.
Watch the highlighted words switch in place. Tap Pause to stop them or Listen to hear pronunciation.
Google Play purchases aren’t available yet. Existing plans can still be restored.
Continuing uses these keys but does not mark them verified. Compare all 12 groups with your friend in person or over a trusted call before marking them verified.
Plans aren’t available from Google Play yet. Please try again later.
Your profile and messages waiting for delivery will be removed from Vipi. Saved chats on this device will also be erased.
You’ll need to download these languages again before translating offline. Your conversations stay on this phone.
That’s your username. Enter your friend’s username to start a conversation.
Sign in to the same account to continue.
Choose a name they’ll recognise and a username to share.
Your friend needs to open Vipi before this first message can be sent. Your message is saved.
The original message below, its sender and your reason will go to Fallible Software for review. The rest of your conversation stays private. Reports are kept for up to 30 days.
I understand and want to chat with vBot.
A message couldn’t be delivered. Your other conversations can continue.
I agree to the Terms of Service and have read the Privacy Policy.
Translation isn’t available for this message. Your original is unchanged.
The keys may have changed, or your choice couldn’t be saved. Compare the current numbers again.
Chat with a chatbot. Requires the separate Bot mini plan.
Google Play took too long to respond. Please try again.
Selected words and short phrases switch between your language and the language you choose. Word order and grammar stay the same.
Encryption details couldn’t be opened. Your verification hasn’t changed.
Save your friend chat history in an encrypted file. You choose where to keep it. Your messaging identity, unsent messages and vBot history stay out of the backup.
We couldn’t refresh your plans. Check your connection and try again.
Your Vipi account and chats on this device will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.
Refresh the current Google Play price before continuing.
Deleting your account won’t cancel a Google Play subscription. You can cancel it separately to stop future renewals.
Only the selected reply text and reason go to Fallible Software for review. Friend conversations aren’t included. Reports are kept for up to 30 days.
vBot is powered by DeepSeek. Messages you send to vBot go to Vipi and DeepSeek to generate replies. Your chats with friends are never included automatically.
Google Play couldn’t open checkout. Refresh your plans and try again.
Exchange a message first to create this conversation’s security number.
Ask vBot a question or talk about your day. vBot is a chatbot and can make mistakes; check important details.

Google Play couldn’t complete the purchase. Please try again.
Translation by Google. Translations can be imperfect.
Confirm password to save a backup
Open Vipi’s notification settings in Android Settings.
Open your phone’s Settings and search for text-to-speech.
Enter their exact Vipi username. Your phone contacts stay private.
Vipi is being prepared for launch. This account isn’t in the preview yet.
Sharing isn’t available. Tell your friend your username instead.
Your saved vBot conversation couldn’t be opened. Close and reopen Vipi to try again.
Choose a shorter excerpt from this reply.
Purchase canceled. Your plans haven’t changed.
This device is connected. Your saved history remains here. Previous waiting messages stopped; your friends will see new encryption keys.
No one was found with that username. Check the spelling with your friend.
Bot mini needs an active Vipi plan. Restore Vipi or manage Bot mini in Google Play to prevent another renewal.
Your saved conversations couldn’t be opened. Please try again.
Start or restore your Vipi plan to send messages. Your saved chats and drafts remain available.
Google Play purchases aren’t available yet. Please try again later.
Can’t connect. Messages are saved here.
This won’t erase friends’ copies or backups you saved elsewhere.
Your Fallsoft sign-in and accounts in other Fallsoft apps will remain.
